purpose: Interactive requirements workflow that drafts a requirements document first and refines it through dialogue with the user when no Figma or screen design exists, for new apps or feature additions.
summary: Required reading list including additive development spec, frontmatter format, requirement format and error classification
Phase 0: confirm what is known from prior conversation and decide whether the work is entirely new
Phase 1: fetch rules and existing assets via search skills, investigate external information
Phase 2: confirm vision, value, scope, constraints and impact
Phase 3: judge pure-additive versus differential type with approval, decide placement, number IDs, write draft with doc_status draft
Phase 4: discuss the draft, scenarios, screen lists, glossary, layered exploration order, write requirements, re-judge type and add temporary marker
Phase 5: quality checks, TBD organization, AI review, remove draft status, DB update, commit, completion guidance
Dialogue principles and anti-patterns specific to requirements definition
Special rules for unresolved items (TBD) and review severity table
Question templates and deliverables list per phase
tasks: Creating requirements from scratch through dialogue
Adding a feature to an existing app requirements set
Judging pure-additive versus differential development type
Managing TBD items in requirements documents
Reviewing requirements for ambiguity and How leakage
title: 対話型要件定義ワークフロー
